newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Vietnam detergent output to hit 252,500T by 2000.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam detergent output to hit 252,500T by 2000.

text.p: Vietnam's production of detergents is forecast to increase to 252,500 tonnes by 2000 from 163,850 tonnes in 1996, an official of the Vietnam National Chemical Corp said on Monday.

Ngo Manh Hoai told an Asia Surfactants conference in Singapore rising consumption will force Vietnam to raise output and will lead to a rise in the use of surfactant chemicals such as animal or plant fatty acids used to make detergents.
"The amount of surfactants used has risen," Ngo said.
The production of surfactant chemicals like linear alkyl benzene sulphonic acid (LAS) or dodecyl benzene sulphonic acid used in making detergents will also increase to meet rising demand, he added.
